book_meta.work: Le Tour du monde en quatre-vingts jours
book_meta.author: Jules Verne

sentences.ar: بهونغ كونغ، فوغ راح يدور على قريب عودا.
sentences.en: In Hong Kong, Fogg went looking for Aouda's relative.
The merchant, her cousin.
And asked in the market, at the bank, at the exchange.
And they told him: gone.
Two years ago.
To Europe.
And Fogg went back to Aouda, and told her.
And Aouda was silent.
And then said: and what do I do now?
Fogg said: you come with us to Europe.
She said: but...

sentences.ar: قال فوغ: ما بيأثر على البرنامج.
sentences.en: Fogg said: it does not affect the programme.
And Fix went to the consulate.
And asked: an arrest warrant?
They said: no.
Not yet.

sentences.ar: وفيكس طلع، وهو بيمشي بالشارع زي المجنون.
sentences.en: And Fix went out, walking the street like a madman.
Hong Kong was the last English soil.

sentences.ar: بعدها، اليابان، وأمريكا، وما إله سلطة.
sentences.en: After it, Japan, America, and he had no authority.
He said: I must stop him here.
Today.
Tonight.
And Passepartout was at the harbour, watching the ships.
And Fix came up to him, his face troubled.
Passepartout said: Mr. Fix!
Tomorrow we sail!
Fix said: yes.
Come and have a drink.
I have something to tell you.
And took him to a place by the harbour.
A dark place, full of smoke.

sentences.ar: وناس مرميين على مقاعد، عيونهم مسكرة.
sentences.en: And people lying on benches, their eyes closed.
An opium den.
